$description: Reference catalog of every custom Scaffolder field extension ("picker") exposed by Witboost's wizard engine (witboost.mesh.ui, plugins/wb-scaffolder). Used via `ui:field: <name>` on a JSON Schema property inside template.yaml / edit-template.yaml. Sourced by reading plugins/wb-scaffolder/src/extensions/default.ts (the registration list) and each picker's component + schema.ts in witboost.mesh.ui.

commonStructure.name: The canonical component name (may back more than one registeredName).
commonStructure.registeredNames: Every string value valid for `ui:field: <value>` that resolves to this component.
commonStructure.category: Rough grouping to help pick the right picker for a use case.
commonStructure.purpose: What the picker is for and when to use it.
commonStructure.sourceFile: Path of the component, relative to the witboost.mesh.ui repo root, for citation purposes.
commonStructure.jsonSchemaType: The JSON Schema `type` (and shape) the property must declare for this picker's output value.
commonStructure.uiOptions: Array of options read from `uiSchema['ui:options']`. Each entry: {name, type, required, default, description}.
commonStructure.otherUiDirectives: Array of other `ui:*` keys (siblings of `ui:field`, NOT inside `ui:options`) this picker reads, e.g. `ui:filter`, `ui:fieldName`, `ui:property`. Each entry: {name, required, default, description}.
commonStructure.fieldLevelConfig: Dedicated field for configuration keys that live directly on the property definition itself (siblings of `type`/`ui:field`, at the SAME level as `title`/`description`) rather than under `ui:options` or as a `ui:*` directive. Empty array if the picker has none. Each entry: {name, required, default, description}.
commonStructure.validation: Description of built-in validation behavior, if any.
commonStructure.async: Whether the picker performs asynchronous work (catalog/API calls) to render options or validate.
commonStructure.example: Minimal YAML snippet of the property definition showing typical usage.

pickers.name: EntityPicker
pickers.purpose: Selects a single entity from the Witboost/Backstage catalog (e.g. a Domain, System, Group or User), with autocomplete search and, by default, the ability to type an arbitrary value not present in the catalog.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: string (entity reference), or the raw Entity object when uiOptions.storeRawEntity is true

uiOptions.name: allowedKinds
uiOptions.description: DEPRECATED, use catalogFilter instead. Restricts selectable entities to these catalog kinds (e.g. Domain, System, Group, User).

uiOptions.name: defaultKind
uiOptions.description: Entity kind assumed by default; options of this kind are rendered without a kind prefix.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Whether to allow typing a value that is not present in the catalog.

uiOptions.name: defaultNamespace
uiOptions.description: Default namespace; options in this namespace are rendered without a namespace prefix.

uiOptions.name: catalogFilter
uiOptions.description: Key/value catalog filter expression(s), e.g. { kind: Domain }. Preferred replacement for allowedKinds.

uiOptions.name: excludeValues
uiOptions.description: Entity references to exclude from the option list.

uiOptions.name: showOnlyUserOwnGroups
uiOptions.description: Show only the Group entities the logged-in user belongs to (requires allowedKinds/catalogFilter to include user/group).

uiOptions.name: storeRawEntity
uiOptions.description: Store the full Entity object in the form data instead of just its entity ref. Used together with DescriptorPicker to let the user drill into the selected entity's spec.

uiOptions.name: ui:widget
uiOptions.description: Overrides the rendered widget.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:filter
otherUiDirectives.description: Array of { fieldName, entityPath } pairs. Filters catalog results to entities whose property at entityPath equals the current value of the sibling form field named fieldName. Used to cascade selections, e.g. filter Systems by the Domain chosen in another field.

pickers.validation: None client-side beyond the configured filters; the catalog is the source of truth for valid values.
pickers.example:
domain:
  title: Domain
  type: string
  description: Domain this component belongs to
  ui:field: EntityPicker
  ui:options:
    allowArbitraryValues: false
    allowedKinds:
      - Domain

pickers.name: EntityNamePicker
pickers.purpose: Free-text input for the display name of a new component or project. Integrates with the wizard's dependency manager so that dependent fields (e.g. auto-generated identifiers) recompute live when the name changes.

uiOptions.name: maxLength
uiOptions.description: Maximum allowed string length.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: If false, disables manual editing of the field.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:autofocus
otherUiDirectives.description: Auto-focuses the input when the step is shown.

pickers.validation: None at picker level.
pickers.example:
name:
  title: Name
  type: string
  description: Display name of the Component.
  ui:field: EntityNamePicker
  default: My Component
  ui:options:
    allowArbitraryValues: true

pickers.name: OwnerPicker
pickers.purpose: Specialized EntityPicker preset for choosing an owner: defaults allowedKinds to Group and User.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: string (entity reference), or the raw Entity object

uiOptions.name: allowedKinds
uiOptions.description: DEPRECATED, use catalogFilter instead. Kinds of entities to derive options from.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Whether to allow arbitrary user input.

uiOptions.name: defaultNamespace
uiOptions.description: The default namespace; options with this namespace are not prefixed.

uiOptions.name: catalogFilter
uiOptions.description: Key/value filter expression(s) for entities.

pickers.validation: None.
pickers.example:
owner:
  title: Owner
  type: string
  ui:field: OwnerPicker

pickers.name: OwnedEntityPicker
pickers.purpose: Like EntityPicker, but restricted to entities owned by (or related to) the current logged-in user.

uiOptions.name: allowedKinds
uiOptions.description: Entity kinds to show.

uiOptions.name: defaultKind
uiOptions.description: Default kind for display.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Allow custom values.

uiOptions.name: defaultNamespace
uiOptions.description: Default namespace for display.

pickers.validation: None.
pickers.example:
myProjects:
  title: My Projects
  type: string
  ui:field: OwnedEntityPicker
  ui:options:
    allowedKinds: [System]

pickers.name: EntitySelectionPicker
pickers.purpose: Reads the value of another field (typically an entity ref chosen via EntityPicker) and copies a nested property from the resolved entity/entities into this field. Used to auto-populate computed or read-only fields, e.g. an owner or a repo-name annotation pulled from a previously selected Data Product.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: string (or array, depending on the source field's cardinality)

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Whether to allow arbitrary user input. Only takes effect if the field's JSON Schema type is 'string'.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:fieldName
otherUiDirectives.description: Name of the source form field holding the entity ref(s) to resolve.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:property
otherUiDirectives.description: Lodash path into the resolved entity/entities used to compute this field's value. Mutually exclusive with mapTo.

otherUiDirectives.name: mapTo
otherUiDirectives.description: Alternative to ui:property: an object (or '.') mapping multiple properties of the resolved entity into an object value. Mutually exclusive with ui:property.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:displayLabel
otherUiDirectives.description: Lodash path used to compute the human-readable label shown for the resolved value.

pickers.validation: Configuration is Zod-validated: exactly one of ui:property or mapTo must be set, otherwise the field is disabled with an error message.
pickers.example:
owner:
  title: Component Owner
  type: string
  description: Automatically selected from the Data Product metadata.
  ui:field: EntitySelectionPicker
  ui:fieldName: dataproduct
  ui:property: spec.owner
  ui:options:
    allowArbitraryValues: false

pickers.name: EntityRelationsPicker
pickers.purpose: Selects entities related to another entity (identified via ui:fieldName) by following a catalog relation (default hasPart). Registered a second time as EntityComponentsPicker, the conventional name used to pick sibling Components belonging to the same Data Product (System), e.g. for a `dependsOn` field.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Whether to allow arbitrary user input.

uiOptions.name: ui:widget
uiOptions.description: The widget to use for the field.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:fieldName
otherUiDirectives.description: Name of the sibling field holding the source entity ref used as the relation's starting point.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:property
otherUiDirectives.description: Optional lodash path resolved on the source entity BEFORE following the relation, when the actual reference entity is nested under a property.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:componentsFilter
otherUiDirectives.description: Keeps only related entities whose spec.type equals this value.

otherUiDirectives.name: ui:filters
otherUiDirectives.description: Array of { key, value }: keeps only related entities where the property at lodash path `key` equals `value`.

fieldLevelConfig.name: returnFormat
fieldLevelConfig.description: Format of each selected value: 'urn' builds a Witboost URN from the entity's kind + name; 'ref' produces a stringified catalog entityRef.

fieldLevelConfig.name: relation
fieldLevelConfig.description: Catalog relation type to traverse from the source entity to find candidate related entities.

pickers.validation: Configuration is Zod-validated against the schema above.
pickers.example:
dependsOn:
  title: Depends on
  type: array
  default: []
  items:
    type: string
    ui:field: EntityComponentsPicker
    ui:fieldName: dataproduct
    ui:options:
      allowArbitraryValues: false

pickers.name: EntitySearchPicker
pickers.purpose: Advanced full-text/knowledge-graph entity search, with optional multi-selection and Witty AI-assisted suggestions. Broader and less filterable than EntityPicker; use it for free-form search-driven entity pickers.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: string | GenericEntityType, or an array of those when multiSelection is true

uiOptions.name: multiSelection
uiOptions.description: Allow selecting multiple entities.

uiOptions.name: entities
uiOptions.description: Configuration of which entity types/filters are searchable and how they are displayed.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Allow arbitrary values not found by search.

uiOptions.name: ui:widget
uiOptions.description: Overrides the rendered widget.

pickers.validation: None at picker level.
pickers.example:
relatedResource:
  title: Related Resource
  type: string
  ui:field: EntitySearchPicker

pickers.name: ReadsFromPicker
pickers.purpose: Composite picker for choosing a data source to consume from: lets the user cascade Domain -> Data Product -> Output Port, or alternatively pick a generic Resource directly, via catalog-backed dropdowns.
pickers.validation: None at picker level.
pickers.example:
readsFrom:
  title: Reads From
  type: string
  ui:field: ReadsFromPicker

pickers.name: IdentifierPicker
pickers.purpose: Auto-generates a Witboost project/system identifier by combining the values of a domain field and a name field elsewhere in the same form, recomputing live as those fields change. Used for Project/System templates (not Components — see ComponentIdentifierPicker).

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: If false, the field is fully disabled for manual editing (auto-generated value only).

uiOptions.name: domainField
uiOptions.description: Name of the sibling field holding the domain value used to compute the identifier.

uiOptions.name: nameField
uiOptions.description: Name of the sibling field holding the name value used to compute the identifier.

pickers.validation: Async — checks the generated identifier's uniqueness against Witboost.
pickers.example:
identifier:
  title: Identifier
  type: string
  description: Autogenerated unique identifier.
  ui:field: IdentifierPicker
  ui:options:
    allowArbitraryValues: false

pickers.name: ComponentIdentifierPicker
pickers.purpose: Like IdentifierPicker, but for Components: auto-generates the identifier from a 'name' field and the component's parent, read from a 'parentRef' field if present, otherwise from a 'dataproduct' field. Always use this (not IdentifierPicker) for Component templates.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: If false, disables manual editing of the auto-generated value.

pickers.validation: Async — component-specific identifier uniqueness check.
pickers.example:
identifier:
  title: Identifier
  type: string
  description: Autogenerated unique identifier. Not editable after creation.
  ui:field: ComponentIdentifierPicker
  ui:options:
    allowArbitraryValues: false

pickers.name: RepoUrlPicker
pickers.purpose: Structured repository picker: lets the user compose a Git repository location (host, owner/namespace, repo name) across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure Repos or Gerrit, with optional per-provider OAuth scope requests. Witboost convention is to auto-generate repoUrl from a naming convention instead of exposing this picker to end users — only use it if the user explicitly wants to pick the repo location manually.

uiOptions.name: schema
uiOptions.description: Labels/placeholders overrides: namespaceTitle, namespaceDescription, namespacePlaceholder, repositoryNameTitle, repositoryNameDescription, repositoryNamePlaceholder.

uiOptions.name: allowedHosts
uiOptions.description: Restricts selectable Git hosts, e.g. ['gitlab.com'].

uiOptions.name: allowedOrganizations
uiOptions.description: Restricts selectable orgs/namespaces.

uiOptions.name: allowedOwners
uiOptions.description: Restricts selectable owners.

uiOptions.name: allowedRepos
uiOptions.description: Restricts selectable repository names.

uiOptions.name: requestUserCredentials
uiOptions.description: Requests an OAuth token with additional scopes. Shape: { secretsKey (string, required): key under which the token is stored for later steps; additionalScopes (object, optional): per-provider extra scopes for gerrit/github/gitlab/bitbucket/azure (string[] each) }.

pickers.validation: repoPickerValidation checks the composed URL is well-formed and its host matches an allowed/known SCM provider.
pickers.example:
repoUrl:
  title: Repository Location
  type: string
  ui:field: RepoUrlPicker
  ui:options:
    allowedHosts:
      - gitlab.com

pickers.name: EntityTagsPicker
pickers.purpose: Multi-select tag input backed by the catalog's existing tag list, with tag-format validation.

uiOptions.name: kinds
uiOptions.description: Restrict suggested tags to those used by entities of these catalog kinds.

uiOptions.name: showCounts
uiOptions.description: Show usage counts next to each suggested tag.

uiOptions.name: helperText
uiOptions.description: Custom helper text describing the expected tag format.

pickers.validation: Each tag must match the catalog tag format (lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by '-', '+' or '#', max 63 characters).
pickers.example:
tags:
  title: Tags
  type: array
  default: []
  ui:field: EntityTagsPicker

pickers.name: DescriptorPicker
pickers.purpose: Builds a dropdown of options by reading an array or a dictionary out of another 'descriptor' object: either the fixed context descriptor (formContext.__consumableInterface__) or the current value of another sibling field. Useful for letting the user pick one row/entry out of a data structure defined elsewhere in the same wizard, e.g. one column out of a schema array field, or one option out of an entity's spec loaded via EntityPicker + storeRawEntity.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: object: { value: <the selected item>, label: string, key: string }

fieldLevelConfig.name: sourceType
fieldLevelConfig.description: 'descriptor' reads the fixed context descriptor (use source: '.'); 'field' reads the current value of another sibling field named by 'source'.

fieldLevelConfig.name: source
fieldLevelConfig.description: When sourceType is 'field', the name of the sibling field to read from. When sourceType is 'descriptor', conventionally '.'.

fieldLevelConfig.name: optionsAt
fieldLevelConfig.description: Lodash path, relative to the resolved descriptor, pointing to the array or plain object to turn into selectable options.

fieldLevelConfig.name: optionsDisplayNameAt
fieldLevelConfig.description: For array/object items that are objects, the property used as the option's display label. Defaults to the array index (array source) or the dictionary key (object source).

pickers.validation: Throws a configuration error if the value at optionsAt is neither an array nor a plain object.
pickers.example:
targetValue:
  title: Target value
  ui:field: DescriptorPicker
  sourceType: field
  source: localRetrieve
  optionsAt: sourceArray

pickers.name: FilePicker
pickers.purpose: Lets the user upload a single file, which is encoded as a base64 data URL and stored as { fileContent, fileName } in the form data.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: object: { fileContent: string (data URL), fileName: string }

fieldLevelConfig.name: accept
fieldLevelConfig.description: HTML input 'accept' attribute value restricting selectable file types, e.g. '.json,.yaml,image/*'.

fieldLevelConfig.name: maxSizeMb
fieldLevelConfig.description: Maximum accepted file size in megabytes; falls back to the platform's configured max HTTP payload size if unset.

pickers.validation: Rejects files exceeding the configured/derived maximum size.
pickers.example:
logo:
  title: Logo
  ui:field: FilePicker
  accept: image/*
  maxSizeMb: 2

pickers.name: CronExpressionPicker
pickers.purpose: Text input specialized for cron expressions, using the field's standard JSON Schema title/description as label/help text, with cron-syntax validation.
pickers.validation: Rejects values that are not a valid cron expression.
pickers.example:
cronExpression:
  title: Cron expression
  type: string
  ui:field: CronExpressionPicker

pickers.name: RegexPicker
pickers.purpose: Generic text input validated against a regular expression. Also registered under two preconfigured names that ship their own built-in rule: PathPicker (filesystem path syntax) and UrlPicker (http/https URL syntax) — for those two, `fieldLevelConfig.validation` is NOT needed.

uiOptions.name: ui:placeholder
uiOptions.description: Placeholder text shown in the empty input.

fieldLevelConfig.name: validation
fieldLevelConfig.description: Required ONLY when ui:field is 'RegexPicker' (PathPicker/UrlPicker have a built-in rule and ignore this). Shape: { regularExpression: string (required), errorMessage: string (optional), flags: string (optional, regex flags) }.

pickers.validation: PathPicker: fixed Windows/Unix filesystem path regex. UrlPicker: must be a valid http(s) URL. RegexPicker: value must match validation.regularExpression, else validation.errorMessage (or a default message) is shown.
pickers.example:
code:
  title: Code
  type: string
  ui:field: RegexPicker
  validation:
    regularExpression: "^[A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$"
    errorMessage: Must look like ABC-1234

pickers.name: CustomUrlPicker
pickers.purpose: Autocomplete field that fetches its selectable options from a customer-provided external microservice API (or from schema.enum), optionally with Witty AI-assisted suggestions. Used for organization-specific dynamic pickers not backed by the catalog.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Allow selecting a custom value not returned by the API.

uiOptions.name: maxNumberToSelect
uiOptions.description: Maximum number of items the user can select.

uiOptions.name: selectedField
uiOptions.description: Name of the form field holding the currently selected value(s), read back by the async validator.

pickers.validation: Async — validates the selection against the external API's response.
pickers.example:
region:
  title: Region
  type: array
  ui:field: CustomUrlPicker
  ui:options:
    selectedField: region

pickers.name: IdentitiesPicker
pickers.purpose: Multi-select picker for Users and/or Groups from the catalog, with filters for membership, service accounts, and exclusions.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: string[] (entity refs) — use type: array with this picker

uiOptions.name: showOnlyUserMemberGroups
uiOptions.description: Show only groups the current user belongs to.

uiOptions.name: showOnlyServiceAccounts
uiOptions.description: Show only service-account identities. Mutually exclusive with excludeServiceAccounts.

uiOptions.name: excludeServiceAccounts
uiOptions.description: Exclude service-account identities. Mutually exclusive with showOnlyServiceAccounts.

uiOptions.name: allowedKinds
uiOptions.description: Restrict to 'user' and/or 'group'.

uiOptions.name: maxIdentities
uiOptions.description: Maximum number of identities selectable.

uiOptions.name: excludeGroups
uiOptions.description: Group entity refs (format group:name or group:namespace/name) to exclude from the options.

pickers.validation: Rejects invalid allowedKinds/excludeGroups formats, rejects setting both showOnlyServiceAccounts and excludeServiceAccounts, and requires at least one selection if the field is required.
pickers.example:
approvers:
  title: Approvers
  type: array
  ui:field: IdentitiesPicker
  ui:options:
    allowedKinds: [user]

pickers.name: UsersAndGroupsPicker
pickers.purpose: Selects Users and/or Groups, optionally scoped to specific RBAC roles or scopes — the data source switches to the RBAC Subjects API when roleIds/scopes are provided — with optional expansion of groups into individual members.
pickers.jsonSchemaType: string (single selection) or string[] (when allowMultiple is true)

uiOptions.name: allowedKinds
uiOptions.description: Restrict selectable entity kinds.

uiOptions.name: allowMultiple
uiOptions.description: Allow selecting multiple subjects.

uiOptions.name: pageSize
uiOptions.description: Number of items per page.

uiOptions.name: roleIds
uiOptions.description: Filter subjects by RBAC role IDs. When set, switches the data source to the RBAC Subjects API.

uiOptions.name: scopes
uiOptions.description: Filter subjects by scopes (URNs or entity refs like domain:finance). When set, switches the data source to the RBAC Subjects API.

uiOptions.name: resolveGroups
uiOptions.description: If true, expands group subjects into their individual user members.

uiOptions.name: ui:widget
uiOptions.description: Overrides the rendered widget.

pickers.validation: None at picker level.
pickers.example:
reviewers:
  title: Reviewers
  type: array
  ui:field: UsersAndGroupsPicker
  ui:options:
    allowMultiple: true

pickers.name: RbacRolePicker
pickers.purpose: Selects an RBAC role id from Witboost's RBAC configuration.

uiOptions.name: allowArbitraryValues
uiOptions.description: Whether to allow a custom role id not present in RBAC.

uiOptions.name: ui:widget
uiOptions.description: Overrides the rendered widget.

pickers.validation: None at picker level.
pickers.example:
role:
  title: Role
  type: string
  ui:field: RbacRolePicker

pickers.name: AccessControlListPicker
pickers.purpose: Selects a subject to add to an Output Port's Access Control List. Requires the wizard to already carry an __consumableInterface__ descriptor (output port + environment) in formContext, typically produced upstream by a ReadsFromPicker/DescriptorPicker flow.

uiOptions.name: max
uiOptions.description: Maximum number of ACL entries (must be >= 1).

pickers.validation: The field is disabled with an error if the required output-port/environment context is missing from formContext.
pickers.example:
acl:
  title: Access Control List
  type: string
  ui:field: AccessControlListPicker
  ui:options:
    max: 10

pickers.name: WittyTextPicker
pickers.purpose: Plain text field enhanced with Witty AI-powered autocomplete suggestions, aware of the surrounding table row when used inside array/table fields.
pickers.validation: None at picker level.
pickers.example:
description:
  title: Description
  type: string
  ui:field: WittyTextPicker

pickers.name: StarPicker
pickers.purpose: Star-rating input.

uiOptions.name: precision
uiOptions.description: Rating granularity: half-star or full-star.

uiOptions.name: maxValue
uiOptions.description: Maximum rating value.

pickers.validation: None.
pickers.example:
rating:
  title: Rating
  type: number
  ui:field: StarPicker

pickers.name: PrototypeStatusPicker
pickers.purpose: Dropdown for selecting a System Prototype's status, rendering a colored status badge per option. Intended only for SystemPrototype status fields, not for general-purpose enums.

uiOptions.name: label
uiOptions.description: Overrides the field label.

pickers.validation: None at picker level.
pickers.example:
prototypeStatus:
  title: Prototype Status
  type: string
  ui:field: PrototypeStatusPicker
